changes.title: Water only lakes
items: Islands prepare ground effects for just their own kinds of lake, keeping the same look.

changes.title: Shader landing limit
items: Slow-loading islands can open with simple ground and marked lakes while their finer details finish.

changes.title: Late house landing
items: On slow journeys your witch lands asleep and wakes to her alarm when the treehouse is ready.

changes.title: Magic polish
items: Magic beams have broader, brighter cores, and shadow magic is easier to see.

changes.title: Expert bot
items: An experimental expert bot is available in bot games.
The experimental expert keeps its exploration destination and slows down near spell spots.
The experimental expert remembers a legend it has seen while approaching its dream.
The experimental expert puts down a requested animal instead of cycling matching sigils.
The experimental expert explores less-seen directions only at full health and away from nearby enemies.
